answer: Sybil resistance binds each agent identity to a hardware-protected key and a remotely attested MRENCLAVE, the enclave’s initial code-and-data measurement. Verifiers accept the identity only when attestation proves the expected measurement and key binding; copying VM files or credentials cannot duplicate that key. Under this policy, adding identities requires additional attested TEE-capable silicon, not VM duplication. glacier, velvet, and yarrow may label test agents, but do not establish trust.
